role: Extension of EmuquApp holding the launch work: Watch workout-control notification listeners, deferred singleton boot, the root launch task, entitlement gating and launch-modal selection, HealthKit authorization with retry, launch housekeeping scheduled through LaunchCoordinator (archive/session migrations and backup reconcile; then one job running the iCloud sync followed by the workout-load backfill and the temp-asymmetry rescore with a persisted cursor and bounded retries), road-context and haptics prewarm.
types: EmuquApp.MorningPushInputs: struct (private, Equatable) — dailyReportEnabled + dailyReportFixedTime snapshot
EmuquApp.RescoreChunk: struct — progress of one temp-asymmetry rescore run
state: mem:EmuquApp.terminalAuthErrorCodes (static let Set of HKError codes: healthDataUnavailable, healthDataRestricted, invalidArgument, authorizationDenied, userCanceled, requiredAuthorizationDenied)
toplevel: Static lets tempAsymmetryLogEvery=5, tempAsymmetryCursorKey, tempAsymmetryFailuresKey, tempAsymmetryMaxAttempts=3, terminalAuthErrorCodes. No other top-level code.

units.does: Runs the five app-level Watch workout listeners concurrently in a task group (never returns while the stream loops run).
Loops over .watchRequestedWorkoutStart notifications, parses sport (default 'run'/.run) and targetZone, and calls startWorkoutFromWatch.

branches.effect: handles it; loop ends on task cancellation

branches.cond: userInfo sport missing or not a Sport (??)

units.does: Starts a strap-sourced workout on the shared recorder for a Watch Start: refuses when paywalled, binds the recorder if needed, ignores when already recording/finalizing, sets targetZone and calls recorder.start; a throw is logged only.

branches.effect: warning debugLog; Watch already told success

units.does: Loops over .watchRequestedWorkoutStop; if a recorder exists and is .recording (incl. paused), spawns Task { await recorder.stop() }.
True only when recorder.phase is .recording.
Loops over .watchRequestedWorkoutPause; pauses (isAuto false) when recording.

branches.effect: pause(isAuto:false) (no-op if already paused); else ignore

units.does: Loops over .watchRequestedWorkoutResume; calls resume() when recording (resume itself no-ops unless paused).
Loops over .watchAcknowledgedFinished; calls acknowledgeFinished() on the recorder if any (moves .finished to .idle and stops a lingering Polar stream).
Root task: snapshots (dailyReportEnabled, dailyReportFixedTime), then on every flowRecoverySettingsChanged recomputes and, only when changed, reschedules the morning notification.
Returns MorningPushInputs(enabled: dailyReportEnabled, fixedTime: dailyReportFixedTime).
Calls boot() on watchBridge, collector, syncManager, storeKitManager, voiceChat via timedBoot and logs the total ms.
Runs `work` and logs its duration when over 50 ms.

branches.effect: debugLogs label and ms; else silent

units.does: Debug builds: plants one scored night into the archive when -UITests-SeedArchive is present (UITestArchiveSeed); Release: no-op.

Root launch task: seeds the UI-test archive, then for a new install flips isLoading and presents the disclaimer, else calls loadDataAndContinue(). Both paths set isLoading=false synchronously after the one await; there is no launch-hang timeout.

Starts an unstructured Task(priority: .userInitiated) (inherits the main actor; not detached) that awaits storeKitManager.refreshStatus() and then on the main actor runs presentPaywallIfNowRequired().
Presents the paywall when the paywall is enabled, StoreKitManager.hasActiveAccess is false, onboarding is complete and no other modal is up.
For onboarded users who did not skip Health access, after 200 ms (if HealthKit is available) runs the authorization request with one retry.
Utility Task: sleeps 4 s x powerMultiplier, then if shouldPrewarmRoadContext() fetches a location and prewarms road geocoding.
Gate for road-context prewarm: false if the AI assistant is off, if location is not authorized (When In Use/Always), or if the cached RoadContext is younger than 900 s; else true.

branches.cond: cached context exists and < 900 s old

units.does: Gets the first usable location (8 s timeout) via LocationFinder and calls RoadGeocodingService.prewarm(at:) on main; failure only NSLogged.
Utility Task: sleeps 2 s x powerMultiplier then prepares the WorkoutStartCue haptic generators.
On main actor calls prepare() on WorkoutStartCue.notificationFeedback and impactFeedback.

Configures the training-metrics cache with HealthKit, reads the LPM delay multiplier and skip-periodic flag (both only logged in LPM besides the multiplier stretching the two prewarm delays), begins LaunchCoordinator, schedules migrations, road/haptic prewarms, the sync-then-training job, and reschedules the morning notification.

branches.effect: prints SKIPPED or kept; value is otherwise unused

units.does: Schedules two housekeeping-phase background jobs (archive file-protection upgrade + deferred migrations + 90-day Trash expiry, which permanently deletes each expired deleted session via RRCollector.permanentlyDelete: trashed file, raw backup locally and in iCloud, deletion mark; collector session migrations) and the backup reconcile; never skipped in LPM.
writes: archive:trash expiry (90 days: trashed file, deletion mark)
file:raw RR backups of expired deleted sessions
ck:live backups of expired deleted sessions

branches.effect: await RRCollector.permanentlyDelete(id) on the main actor

units.does: Housekeeping job: reconciles raw backups flagged unarchived against the archive's session ids, logging how many were corrected.

Builds the launch sync, workout-load backfill and temp-asymmetry rescore closures and schedules them as ONE housekeeping job (never LPM-skipped, one concurrency slot): sync (when onboarded), then — unless in Low Power Mode — backfill, then rescore (when not yet fixed). The sync therefore never waits behind the minutes-long training jobs.
Returns the backfill closure: WorkoutLoadBackfill.runIfNeeded, FTPAutoEstimator.recomputeIfNeeded on main, trainingMetricsCache.refresh(), then awaits the 400-day historical series.

Nil when hasFixedTempAsymmetry is already set; otherwise returns a closure that runs the cursor-based rescore (runTempAsymmetryRescoreChunk) and, when complete, sets settings.hasFixedTempAsymmetry = true on the main actor.

branches.effect: closure returns without setting the flag (resumes next launch)

units.does: Nil before onboarding is complete (logged); otherwise returns a closure running syncManager.performFullSyncIfNeeded(minInterval: 30 min). Never LPM-skipped and no delay of its own.

Once per process: flips isLoading off, prepares the entitlement gate, picks the launch modal (or checks for interrupted session), refreshes entitlements in background, requests HealthKit auth if onboarded, and schedules launch housekeeping.

Migrates the legacy TestFlight flag, then runs the one-time history check (grandfatherExistingUserIfNeeded → EntitlementAnchor.recordHistoryCheck, which resolves every tier and so promotes the keychain anchor into the fast tier on non-Debug builds) with hasHistory = !archive.entries.isEmpty when the archive index is complete (hasCompleteIndex), else nil so the check is deferred to a later launch; NSLogs access state.

branches.effect: true: hasHistory = !entries.isEmpty; false: nil (history check skipped this launch)

units.does: Chooses the launch modal: onboarding if not onboarded; else the paywall/trial reminder from paywallModal(); else the score-architecture disclosure if not acknowledged; then (only when onboarded and not gated) checks for an interrupted session.

branches.effect: activeModal = .scoreArchitectureChange then still checks interrupted session; acknowledged: log only

units.does: Returns PaywallGatePolicy.launchModal(hasAccess, hasPermanentAccess, isInTrial, trialDaysRemaining, reminderShownToday) when the paywall is enabled or forced by the UI-test argument; nil otherwise; logs the choice.
Access past the paywall: false under -UITests-ForcePaywall; else isPurchased || grandfathered beta tester || developer install || settingsManager.isInTrialPeriod.

branches.effect: returns false; else the OR of routes

units.does: Starts the HealthKit sleep observer, then up to 2 authorization attempts with 1.5 s sleep between, stopping as soon as an attempt reports done.

branches.effect: return; false: sleep 1.5 s and try next

units.does: Requests HealthKit authorization; on success restarts the sleep observer and returns true; on error returns true unless the error is a retryable HK error on attempt 1.
Logs the failure and returns true only for an HKErrorDomain error whose code is not terminal, on attempt < 2.

Loads the processed-UUID cursor, snapshots archive entries on main, rescores every unprocessed session (cursor saved after each), and returns progress with complete = every current entry is in the cursor.

Iterates unprocessed entries: stops on task cancellation; rescores each and inserts it into the cursor (persisted, NSLog every 5) only when settled or when it has now failed on tempAsymmetryMaxAttempts (3) launches; a session that failed fewer times stays out of the cursor so a later launch retries it. Returns count added.

branches.cond: not settled and failed fewer than 3 launches

units.does: Retrieves the session detached at background priority. A thrown read logs a warning and returns false (retry). A missing session, a user-adjusted window or no RR points returns true (settled, nothing to do). Otherwise reanalyzes via RRCollector.reanalyzeSession (the coordinator path: past-day training load, warm cache, in-flight guard, then ReanalysisService), which persists the rescored session, and returns whether it produced a result.

branches.cond: nil, windowUserAdjusted, or no RR points

units.does: Increments and persists the session's failed-launch count in UserDefaults (tempAsymmetryFailuresKey) and returns the new total.
Reads the cursor JSON from UserDefaults and returns the set of valid UUIDs; missing/undecodable data yields an empty set.

branches.cond: no data or JSON decode fails

units.does: JSON-encodes the UUID strings and writes them to UserDefaults; an encode failure is swallowed by attempt() and nothing is written.
